about.title: Who, what, and why
about.mission: Tovy was founded to bring peace and control to complex data environments. We believe technology only works for you when it creates a sense of calm and overview, allowing you to focus on what truly matters.

ceo.name: Giel Nijkamp
ceo.bio: My passion is creating systems that bring peace and clarity. I have seen too many smart entrepreneurs get stuck in data chaos. For me, 'Freedom' is the core: the freedom to run your business without being held back by technology. This means I give you direct access to the core, without unnecessary layers. I build the foundation that gives you control, so you can focus on what counts: growing your business. The best part of my work? That moment a client realizes their data is accurate, their processes are running, and there is finally time for innovation. That is the impact I want to make.

tech.title: Technology
tech.desc: We use proven, stable technology to lay a reliable foundation. No hype, just systems that keep working and provide peace of mind.

optimization.title: Optimization
optimization.desc: The core of peace is a system that runs smoothly. We eliminate noise and build efficient processes that work silently and reliably for you.

innovation.title: Innovation

strategic.desc: A clear direction is the basis of control. We help you make the right long-term technological choices so your IT landscape remains scalable and future-proof. No complex reports, just a clear and feasible plan.

cloud.desc: A stable, secure, and scalable cloud environment forms the foundation of a carefree operation. We proactively design and manage your Azure environment so you can rely on maximum uptime, performance, and security.

automation.desc: We replace repetitive, manual tasks with smart, automated workflows. This not only saves time but also eliminates the chance of errors, leading to a more efficient, peaceful, and scalable business process.

questions.question: What kind of problems does Tovy solve?
questions.answer: Tovy solves the chaos caused by manual data processes. A concrete example is the daily, error-prone task of transferring Shopify orders to Exact Online. We build a seamless, automatic connection that takes over this process entirely. This provides peace of mind and ensures data that is always accurate.

questions.question: How does Tovy's approach differ from a traditional IT partner?
questions.answer: Our focus is on building a foundation, not on selling hours. You have direct contact with me, the engineer. No project managers or account managers. This ensures an efficient process and a solution perfectly tailored to your practice, resulting in a system you fully understand and control.

questions.question: For what type of company is Tovy most suitable?
questions.answer: Our approach is ideal for companies where data integrity is crucial. E-commerce and trading companies, for example, that depend on perfect synchronization between stock, sales, and finance. If the stress of inconsistent data is hampering your growth, we are the right partner.

questions.question: Why would I choose Tovy over a large data consulting firm?
questions.answer: We offer in-depth expertise but without the sluggishness and overhead. We work in short, focused 6-week sprints to quickly deliver a working solution that brings immediate peace and control. Our focus is on building a sustainable system, not on maximizing billable hours.

questions.question: What exactly do I get for the project starting price?
questions.answer: In 6 weeks, we deliver a concrete, working solution. For example: a fully configured data platform in Azure, an automated pipeline that synchronizes your sales data from Shopify to Exact Online, and a Power BI dashboard with your key KPIs. A complete foundation for control and insight.

questions.question: How can I book an introductory meeting?
questions.answer: You can start by filling out the project intake form. This form helps us understand your situation so our first conversation is directly focused on creating a solution.

questions.question: What is the average implementation time?
questions.answer: A foundational data system, including your first automated workflow, is typically up and running within 6 weeks. From that moment on, you will immediately experience the peace of an automated process.

questions.question: Where can I find technical case studies?
questions.answer: In our Knowledge Hub, we openly share our methods and technical approach. Transparency is a core value; we want you to understand exactly how we realize peace and control in your systems.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: Privacy is important to Tovy. It is Tovy's policy to respect your privacy when collecting data via the website. This policy complies with the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR).

sections.title: Data controller
sections.content: Tovy is the data controller for personal data collected through this website. For questions, you can contact Tovy via:

sections.title: Data collection and use
sections.content: Tovy only requests personal data when necessary to provide a service. The organization collects data lawfully, with your knowledge and explicit consent. The legal grounds for processing are consent, contractual necessity, and legitimate interest.
list: Project request form: Tovy collects names, contact details (email, phone), company information, and project details. This data is stored in Google Cloud Firestore and used to assess requests. The basis is the intention to enter into an agreement.

Server logs: The web server, hosted by Firebase Hosting, automatically records requests such as IP addresses, browser types, and visited pages. The basis is the legitimate interest in maintaining a secure website.
Cookies: Tovy uses necessary cookies to manage your consent preferences. The organization does not use tracking cookies without your explicit prior consent via the cookie banner.

sections.title: Data location and transfer
sections.content: To protect data, the primary database (Cloud Firestore) is configured within the European Union (region 'eur3'). Although the organization prefers EU services, some subcontractors may transfer data internationally. This is done exclusively via legally permitted mechanisms, such as standard contractual clauses.

sections.title: Retention and security
sections.content: Tovy only retains personal data as long as necessary for service delivery or as legally required. The organization protects data with commercially standard security measures to prevent loss, theft, and unauthorized access.

sections.title: Rights under the GDPR
sections.content: Under the GDPR, you have the following rights regarding your personal data:
list: Right to information: Knowing how your data is collected and used
Right of access: Requesting a copy of the stored information
Right to rectification: Having incorrect data corrected
Right to erasure: Requesting to have data deleted
Right to restriction: Having processing temporarily paused
Right to portability: Receiving data in a machine-readable format
Right to object: Objecting to the processing of personal data
sections.footer: To exercise these rights, you can contact us via the email address below.

privacy.effectiveDate: This policy has been in effect since July 30, 2024.
